comment: The inventory includes ownership and operation but not recurrent cost, contract conditions, licence obligations, supplier dependency, hosting, support, or data-exit conditions. These are essential to sustainability decisions.

anchor.note: p.89 l.Lines 35-38 read as the printed page; section 4.1.2 agrees

public.text: The inventory includes ownership and operation but not recurrent cost, contract conditions, licence obligations, supplier dependency, hosting, support, or data-exit conditions. These are essential to sustainability decisions.
public.suggestedRevision: Require collection of total cost of ownership, funding source, contract term, licence model, hosting arrangement, support model, supplier concentration, data portability, source-code access where relevant, and exit or transition provisions.
